comments: Test if adding a 22nd land improves the deck. Compares current 21-land config (9I, 7F) against 22-land configs with either an extra Island or extra Forest. Tests Island counts 9-11 to see the impact.

experiments.comment: First: Tests current baseline (9I) vs more Islands. Since we're compensating with Forest, 9I baseline = 21 lands, 10I = 21 lands, 11I = 21 lands. We'll need to manually test 22 lands.
